title: IARU regional band plans (amateur radio)
disclaimer: Hand-transcribed from the IARU regional band plan documents listed under 'sources'. Band plans are voluntary guidance; national regulations take precedence and can be stricter (narrower bands, other segments, power or mode limits, licence class restrictions). Not every country has every band.

1.name: IARU Region 1
1.area: Europe, Africa, Middle East, northern Asia

sources.title: IARU Region 1 HF Band Plan
sources.version: Effective from 16 Oct 2020 (General Conference Novi Sad), edited by DF5JL

sources.title: IARU Region 1 VHF band plan

sources.title: IARU Region 1 UHF band plan
sources.version: Effective December 2020 (VGC Novi Sad), edited by ON4AVJ 18/03/2020

notes: Frequencies are transmitted frequencies, not the suppressed carrier (dial) frequency.
Lowest dial setting for LSB voice: 1843, 3603, 7053 kHz. Highest USB voice dial on 60 m: 5363 kHz.
On 20 m to 10 m the maximum USB voice dial setting should be 3 kHz below the upper band edge.
630 m and 60 m entries are 'proposed usage' in the source.
Unmanned transmitting stations on HF shall only be activated under operator control (except agreed beacons) and must stay within the band plan frequency and bandwidth limits.
The 3600-3620 and 3600-3650 kHz rows overlap in the source and are kept as published.
The VHF plan lists 50.5-52 MHz both as a single 12 kHz all-mode row and as finer sub-rows; only the single row is transcribed here.

2.name: IARU Region 2
notes: Frequencies are transmitted frequencies, not the suppressed carrier (dial) frequency.
ACDS are allowed only where explicitly specified on a segment; unattended operation on HF should be limited.
Segments marked with (*) in the source allow DSB AM phone with max 6 kHz bandwidth; this is noted in 'usage'.
Source typos corrected: 17 m '18095-15105' read as 18095-18105 kHz; 10 m repeater outputs '29620 to 26690' read as 29620-29690 kHz.
The 3600-3625 and 3600-3650 kHz rows overlap in the source and are kept as published.
Above 450 MHz (33 cm and up) the Region 2 plan is not transcribed here.

3.name: IARU Region 3

sources.title: IARU Region 3 Interim Band Plan (Document R3-004)
sources.version: Revised 3 September 2019 (adopted at the R3 Directors' meeting, Tokyo); file name says rev.2

notes: The Region 3 plan is labelled 'interim' in the source.
Phone is SSB, DSB AM, FM and digital voice up to 6 kHz (up to 25 kHz on 50 MHz and above).
The 20 m rows 14070-14110 and 14100-14112 kHz overlap in the source and are kept as published.
The 10 m rows 29510-29590 and 29520-29620 kHz overlap in the source and are kept as published.
The 30 m plan starts at 10110 kHz although the band (ITU allocation) starts at 10100 kHz.
The 60 m 5366-5366.5 kHz segment has a suggested max bandwidth of 20 Hz (footnote).
Above 440 MHz (23 cm and up) the Region 3 plan is not transcribed here.
